GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening for details Presentation skills., which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for details Presentation skills..
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for details Presentation skills..
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening for details Presentation skills..
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for details Presentation skills..

2. When practising Comprehensive listening ‘free-style’ speaking Verbal and non- verbal cues, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehensive listening ‘free-style’ speaking Verbal and non- verbal cues.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehensive listening ‘free-style’ speaking Verbal and non- verbal cues.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Comprehensive listening ‘free-style’ speaking Verbal and non- verbal cues.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Comprehensive listening ‘free-style’ speaking Verbal and non- verbal cues.

3. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Good night
   B. Good day / hello
   C. Thank you
   D. Please

4. When practising Reading for details, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for details.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading for details.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for details.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading for details.

5. When practising ● Speed reading ● Evaluative reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for ● Speed reading ● Evaluative reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to ● Speed reading ● Evaluative reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” ● Speed reading ● Evaluative reading.
   D. Copy random text without understanding ● Speed reading ● Evaluative reading.

6. When practising Reading for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Comprehension.

7. When practising Active listening Public speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Active listening Public speaking.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active listening Public speaking.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Active listening Public speaking.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Active listening Public speaking.

8. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Schule
   B. Haus
   C. Wasser
   D. Buch

9. When practising Listening for Information Public speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information Public speaking.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information Public speaking.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information Public speaking.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information Public speaking.

10. When practising Listening for information Conversational Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for information Conversational Skills.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening for information Conversational Skills.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for information Conversational Skills.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for information Conversational Skills.

11. When practising Extensive reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Extensive reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Extensive reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Extensive reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Extensive reading.

12. When practising Intensive reading Extensive reading Reservations and bookings ● Planning a holid, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Intensive reading Extensive reading Reservations and bookings ● Planning a holid.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Intensive reading Extensive reading Reservations and bookings ● Planning a holid.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Intensive reading Extensive reading Reservations and bookings ● Planning a holid.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Intensive reading Extensive reading Reservations and bookings ● Planning a holid.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Language Structures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Adjectives: Declension of Adjectives Genitive and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
